newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cap wants Daimler unit out - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cap wants Daimler unit out - paper.

text.p: The management of French computer systems house Cap Gemini wants German group Debis to give up its shareholding, accusing the Daimler-Benz AG unit of lack of ambition, business daily La Tribune reported on Wednesday.
"Cap can manage on its own...It is better that Debis leaves," the newspaper reported, without giving a source. Debis' hoped-for departure was also aimed at denying it control of Cap, it said.
Cap's first half sales were up 16 percent, better than analysts' forecasts, and that should continue in the second half, the report said.

The newspaper reported that Cap's managers resented what they saw as Debis' "inertia, lack of ambition, lack of interest in an alliance, which when it was signed in 1991, carried with it the hopes of a grand industrial alliance".

The German firm's ownership has also meant Cap's ambitions were blocked in the United States, due to U.S. legislation, it said. "The partnership with Daimler has never brought anything concrete," it said.
